description: Use when the user first connects Hermoso or asks what it can do. Answers up to five concrete ways to start, tailored to their brand and what is connected (make a video or image ad, launch a business from an idea, grow the one they have, post every day, run ads, see and clone what competitors run), each with an example ask in plain words and the one call that starts it. Offer them as short choices with their example asks. Free, read-only.
